contract.coordinates: Original Python str Unicode code-point indices, start inclusive/end exclusive; not UTF-8 bytes or UTF-16 units. No Unicode normalization.
contract.exactness: 0 <= start < end <= len(query); text == query[start:end]; text == text.strip(). Boundary whitespace uses Python str.isspace, matching default str.strip. Internal whitespace and characters unchanged.
contract.implementation: Trim start/end locally within the original interval; slice text from that interval. No global find or occurrence guessing.
contract.same_family: Separate ordered original spans retained even for same canonical family/profile, different entity or repeated identical substring. Candidate.profile_ids and the ordered source-ID tuples within obligation_spans remain unchanged.
contract.candidate_spans: tuple[(start,end,tuple[source_profile_ids,...]),...] in original obligation order; exact corrected offsets from evidence. B source_start/source_end should consume these original coordinates without relaxed matching.
contract.single_requests: retrieve_obligations(single atomic query) returns [] as before. Use _compound_parts for atomic span and retrieve_profiles for support.
contract.retrieval_views: merge_aggregation=False only exposes bounded local BM25 views, not execution obligations; these views also have exact spans.

budgets.top_k: Use None for all-obligation certification; other values may truncate intentionally

contract.purity: No network/model/business API/SQL/filesystem mutation during construction or retrieval; template data unchanged.
contract.validation_boundary: Invalid ranges/wrong entity/occurrence controls test an exact local validator. No new range-accepting runtime API or changes to B validator; B execution/selection/parameter policy require independent testing.
contract.region: No region or default parameter introduced or applied.
